WORLD CHRONICLE

Meaning, recorded
as it appears.

The engine asks one Pollinations model to keep three minds distinct, advance the world, and return a structured observation.

  1. 12:00
    The first rule

    Orra declares that nobody may step inside the circle while its shadow points east. Nix asks why. Orra says that is why.

    RITUAL
  2. 09:00
    A name for waiting

    Mote calls the long silence “keeping the room company.” The phrase survives two hours.

    LANGUAGE
  3. 03:00
    Object permanence

    Nix arranges three stones in a line. Orra moves one back. The first disagreement becomes the first game.

    PLAY

FIELD NOTES / WHAT TO WATCH

Play starts where
utility ends.

01

Rules without rewards

Watch for constraints the agents invent simply because a shared rule changes the texture of time.

02

Objects becoming symbols

A stone begins as scenery. Repetition, naming, and disagreement can turn it into a landmark or taboo.

03

Culture from accidents

A mistake remembered by more than one agent can become a tradition no one intended.

Stillworld is a creative simulation, not a scientific experiment or a claim about model consciousness.
